set.body:
Source: review finding in FileJournalControlStore.scala:121-147.

Problem:
events re-decodes and replays the journal from byte zero under the writer semaphore on every poll even though state already retains recent events. Poll cost is O(journal) and blocks transactions.

Acceptance:
- Serve the common recent-cursor path from the bounded in-memory event cache without taking the writer lock for full-file replay.
- Define a correct fallback for cursors older than the cache, including compaction/torn-tail semantics.
- Keep cursor and truncation behavior explicit.
- Add concurrency and scale tests showing normal polling cost does not grow with journal length and writers are not held behind replay.
set.title: P6f.10: Serve journal event polls from bounded state
